lines.gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: khat darasan bhramate phirahi nah mileeai bhekha(n) ||
lines.translation: The followers of the six orders wander and roam around wearing religious robes, but they do not meet God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾਇਣਾ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: varat karahi cha(n)draainaa se kitai na lekha(n) ||
lines.translation: They keep the lunar fasts, but they are of no account.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਸੰਪੂਰਨਾ ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪੇਖੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed paRahi sa(n)pooranaa tat saar na pekha(n) ||
lines.translation: Those who read the Vedas in their entirety, still do not see the sublime essence of reality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਲਕੁ ਕਢਹਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਲੇਖੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tilak kadhahi isanaan kar a(n)tar kaalekha(n) ||
lines.translation: They apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, and take cleansing baths, but they are blackened within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੀ ਸਿਖੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhekhee prabhoo na labhaee vin sachee sikha(n) ||
lines.translation: They wear religious robes, but without the True Teachings, God is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa maarag so pavai jis dhur masatak lekha(n) ||
lines.translation: One who had strayed, finds the Path again, if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖੰ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin janam savaariaa aapanaa jin gur akhee dekha(n) ||13||
lines.translation: One who sees the Guru with his eyes, embellishes and exalts his human life. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਨਿਵਾਹੂ ਗਡਿ ਜੋ ਚਲਾਊ ਨ ਥੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: so nivaahoo gad jo chalaaoo na theeai ||
lines.translation: Focus on that which will not pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰ ਕੂੜਾਵੀ ਛਡਿ ਸੰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaar kooRaavee chhad sa(n)mal sach dhanee ||1||
lines.translation: Abandon your false actions, and meditate on the True Master. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਭ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਘਟਾਊ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: habh samaanee jot jiu jal ghataaoo cha(n)dramaa ||
lines.translation: God's Light is permeating all, like the moon reflected in the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਥੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paragat theeaa aap naanak masatak likhiaa ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself is revealed, O Nanak, to one who has such destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਉ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh suhaave naam chau aath pahar gun gaau ||
lines.translation: One's face becomes beautiful, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੰਨੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daragah ma(n)neeahi milee nithaave thaau ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, in the Court of the Lord, you shall be accepted; even the homeless find a home there. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰ ਭੇਖਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar bhekh na paaeeai prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
lines.translation: By wearing religious robes outwardly, God, the Inner-knower is not found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਿਕਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas har jeeu baaharee sabh phirai nikaamee ||
lines.translation: Without the One Dear Lord, all wander around aimlessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਨਿਤ ਗਰਬਿ ਫਿਰਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man rataa kuta(n)b siu nit garab phiraamee ||
lines.translation: Their minds are imbued with attachment to family, and so they continually wander around, puffed up with pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਗਰਬਹਿ ਦਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: phirahi gumaanee jag mahi kiaa garabahi daamee ||
lines.translation: The arrogant wander around the world; why are they so proud of their wealth?

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਖਿਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaladiaa naal na chalaee khin jaai bilaamee ||
lines.translation: Their wealth shall not go with them when they depart; in an instant, it is gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਚਰਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਹੁਕਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bicharade phirahi sa(n)saar mahi har jee hukaamee ||
lines.translation: They wander around in the world, according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਖੁਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam khulaa gur paaiaa har miliaa suaamee ||
lines.translation: When one's karma is activated, one finds the Guru, and through Him, the Lord and Master is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo jan har kaa sevako har tis kee kaamee ||14||
lines.translation: That humble being, who serves the Lord, has his affairs resolved by the Lord. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖਹੁ ਅਲਾਏ ਹਭ ਮਰਣੁ ਪਛਾਣੰਦੋ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukhahu alaae habh maran pachhaana(n)do koi ||
lines.translation: All speak with their mouths, but rare are those one who realize death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਾ ਯਕੀਨਾ ਹਿਕ ਸਿਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tinaa khaak jinaa yakeenaa hik siu ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak is the dust of the feet of those who have faith in the One Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਵਸੰਦੋ ਮੰਝਿ ਪਛਾਣੂ ਕੋ ਹੇਕੜੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaan vasa(n)do ma(n)jh pachhaanoo ko hekaRo ||
lines.translation: Know that He dwells within all; rare are those who realize this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਤਨਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tai tan paRadaa naahi naanak jai gur bhetiaa ||2||
lines.translation: There is no obscuring veil on the body of that one, O Nanak, who meets the Guru. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤੜੀ ਕਾਂਢਕੁ ਆਹ ਪਾਵ ਧੋਵੰਦੋ ਪੀਵਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mataRee kaa(n)dhak aah paav dhova(n)do peevasaa ||
lines.translation: I drink in the water which has washed the feet of those who share the Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਥਾਹ ਪਸਣ ਕੂ ਸਚਾ ਧਣੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: moo tan prem athaah pasan koo sachaa dhanee ||3||
lines.translation: My body is filled with infinite love to see my True Master. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nirabhau naam visaariaa naal maaiaa rachaa ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord, he becomes attached to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavai jaai bhavaaeeai bahu jonee nachaa ||
lines.translation: He comes and goes, and wanders, dancing in countless incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਚਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਤੈ ਖਿਸਕਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੋਲੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bachan kare tai khisak jaai bole sabh kachaa ||
lines.translation: He gives his word, but then backs out. All that he says is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਥੋਥਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਕੂੜੀ ਸਭ ਖਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)darahu thothaa kooRiaar kooRee sabh khachaa ||
lines.translation: The false person is hollow within; he is totally engrossed in falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਾਲਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: vair kare niravair naal jhoothe laalachaa ||
lines.translation: He tries to take vengeance upon the Lord, who bears no vengeance; such a person is trapped by falsehood and greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maariaa sachai paatisaahi vekh dhur karamachaa ||
lines.translation: The True King, the Primal Lord God, kills him when He sees what he has done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਦੂਤੀ ਹੈ ਹੇਰਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jamadootee hai heriaa dukh hee mahi pachaa ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death sees him, and he rots away in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਆ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: hoaa tapaavas dharam kaa naanak dar sachaa ||15||
lines.translation: Even-handed justice is administered, O Nanak, in the Court of the True Lord. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: parabhaate prabh naam jap gur ke charan dhiaai ||
lines.translation: In the early hours of the morning, chant the Name of God, and meditate on the Feet of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran mal utarai sache ke gun gaai ||1||
lines.translation: The filth of birth and death is erased, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: deh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)njee naam vihooneeaa ||
lines.translation: The body is dark, blind and empty, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saphal jana(n)m jai ghat vuthaa sach dhanee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, fruitful is the birth of one, within whose heart the True Master dwells. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: loin loee dith piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||
lines.translation: With my eyes, I have seen the Light; my great thirst for Him is not quenched.
